# CoLab AI

CoLab is an AI-powered engineering collaboration platform that helps product development teams make better design decisions, faster. Manufacturers use CoLab to run design reviews, capture expert feedback, and create a centralized record of decisions and engineering knowledge.

By connecting engineering knowledge with CAD, PLM, and other product data, CoLab enables teams, suppliers, and stakeholders to collaborate more effectively. Feedback, issues, approvals, and design context are captured in a single system, improving traceability, reducing rework, and accelerating product development.

CoLab's AI capabilities help teams surface relevant knowledge, automate review activities, and apply organizational expertise at scale by improving design quality, preserving institutional knowledge, and bringing better products to market faster.
